headline: Uganda Launches First African Trial of mRNA Bundibugyo Ebola Vaccine
summary: The Uganda Virus Research Institute launched Africa's first clinical trial for an mRNA Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine in collaboration with manufacturer Moderna.
why: Clinical trials for vaccine development by biotechnology companies represent key research milestones influencing long-term pharmaceutical product pipelines.

impacts.name: Moderna
impacts.why: Progress in clinical trials expands commercial vaccine development pipelines.
